post.summary: Authenticates a user and returns an access token and a refresh token.
Refreshes the expired access token using a valid refresh token.

requestBody.description: Optional request body containing the refresh token (if not in cookies).

post.summary: Logs out the user by deleting the refresh token cookie.

get.summary: Retrieves the current authenticated user's information from the JWT claims.
Confirms a user's email address using the userId and a generated confirmation code.

post.summary: Initiates the password reset process by sending a token to the user's email.
Resets the user's password using a valid token.

CREATE ROUTE (POST) - Register a new route.
Ensure the JSON payload contains at least 2 Spots.

get.summary:
GET ROUTES (GET) - Fetch a paginated list of routes for the Explore feed.
Supports filtering by CategoryId and SearchTerm.

GET ROUTE DETAILS (GET) - Fetch a complete route including its ordered sequence of stops (Spots).
This is public (anyone can view a route).

GET NEARBY ROUTES (GET) - Fetch a list of routes near a specific location.
Uses PostGIS spatial queries under the hood. Radius is in meters (default 5000 = 5km).

post.summary:
CREATE SPOT (POST) - Register a new physical location in the system.
Requires the user to be authenticated.

Bearer.description: Input your Bearer token in this format - Bearer {your token here} to access this API
Bearer.name: Authorization
